a.lede: Meta will now allow you to build customized, app-like experiences within its Muse AI assistant. The new feature, called "spaces," allows Muse to build things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, which you can interact with directly in the app. If you connect your space to a relevant app, […]
a.title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now

b.lede: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
b.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
